24 October 2024 – 1 November 2024 |pass_dates = 23 October 2024 – 2 December 2024 |acts = 3 |act_name = Nights |tracks = 2 |part_of = Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:The Haunt|The Haunt]] |previous_event = [[The Classic Event|The Classic]] |next_event = [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event|Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE]] |previous_pass = [[Krampus' Revenge Event#Krampus' Revenge Season Pass|Krampus' Revenge]] |next_pass = [[Operation I.C.E Event|Operation I.C.E]] }} {{ScrollTOC|450px}} ==Description== The '''Hexscape Event''' was the seventeenth event to be added in Tower Defense Simulator. It brought two new towers and a battle pass. The event featured three nights, being different maps with unique enemies and wave structure, with each night getting harder. The [[Failed Gateway|first night]] was released a few minutes after the [[v1.37.0|Hexscape Update]] released on the 23rd of October 2024, 19:00 UTC, the [[The Nightmare Realm|second night]] released on the 25th of October 2024, 19:00 UTC and the [[Containment|third night]] released on the 30th of October 2024, 19:00 UTC. This event was also part of Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:The Haunt|The Haunt]] event. On the right side of the screen, which could be used to take screenshots to submit for the event. A catalog button was also added for the event so that players could equip any avatar item that they want. The event started on the 23rd of October 2024 at 19:00 UTC and ended on the 20th of November 2024 at 20:00 UTC. ==Hexscape Event Battle Pass== [[File:HexscapeBattlePass.png|center|thumb|500px]] {{CandyCorns|Candy Corns}} were the currency used for the '''Hexscape Event Battle Pass''', which could be collected from enemies. Event maps had a higher chance of dropping {{CandyCorns|Candy Corns}}, with later nights having better odds. Additionally, on weekends, a [[Battlepass Boost]] was applied, boosting {{CandyCorns|Candy Corns}} drops by 50%. These enemies dropped between one and three {{CandyCorns|Candy Corns}} on death and could be collected by walking near them. These currency drops did not give one {{CandyCorns|Candy Corn}} each. The number varied based on the mode played. In total, it would take {{CandyCorns|27,080}} or {{Robux|3,740}} ({{Robux|2,805}} during the Black Friday 2024 Sale) to complete the battle pass. It had two tracks, the regular track obtained for free and a premium track purchasable for {{Robux|499}}. During the Black Friday 2024 Sale, it had a cost of {{Robux|299}}. Certain items like [[High Grade Crate]]s are given out multiple times. In total, the '''Hexscape Event Battle Pass''' gives out {{Coins|1,750}}, {{Exp|875}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|7}}, 8 [[Nuke]]s, 11 [[High Grade Crate]]s, 2 [[Premium Crate]]s, {{SpinTicket|18}}, 3 [[Supply Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} HexscapeEventCountdownIcon.png HexscapeNight1Icon.png TheHauntIcon.png HexscapeNight2Icon.png HexscapeNight3Icon.png HexscapeNight3Icon Normal.png {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HexscapeNight1Thumbnail.png TheHauntThumbnail.png HexscapeNight2Thumbnail.png HexscapeNight3Thumbnail.png HexscapeRegularNight3Thumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HexscapePI1.jpg HexscapePI2.jpg HexscapePI3.jpg HexscapeEventPI.png HexscapeNight3PI.png }} ==Trivia== *The '''Hexscape Event''' is the first event to have unique soundtracks that would be played when triumphing or losing a match. **All the soundtracks were remixes and variations of the soundtracks added in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]]. **These were since reused in the [[Null & Void Event]]. *The '''Hexscape Event''' is the first event to have a battle pass with two tracks. **It is also the first event to have a paid battle pass track, only being bought with Robux. *The '''Hexscape Event''' is the first event since the [[Frost Invasion Event]] to have it possible for players to solo the event. **It is also the first [[Matchmaking]]-only event to freely allow solo matches. *Prior to the '''Hexscape Event''', the lobby would use the same theater model and countdown display as the [[Lunar Overture Event]] before the lobby would get reworked. *Interestingly, none of the skins in the battle pass have the {{Color|Event}} rarity, instead having regular rarities. **However, the skins obtained from [[Mission Quests]] do use the {{Color|Event}} rarity. *Unlike other events, the '''Hexscape Event''' ended before the battle pass did instead of them both ending at the same time. ==Notes== {{EventNavBox}} [[Category:Passes]]
